Subject: Evidence ask: compact roster + SCIM delta for Finx Prod

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking this — Crowe is starting our access review for Finx Prod next week and they asked us for a compact evidence packet focused on service accounts and role ownership. Can Redwood provide the following by EOD Friday 11/28?

- A compact role ownership roster for the Finx production tenant (CSV or Excel) showing role -> owner -> provisioning method
- SCIM delta sample covering a 48h window (we don't need the whole history, just a delta extract for the period 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-02)
- A short justification file for any privileged/service accounts >1 in the last 90 days
- SAML assertion samples for wave-length sessions (anonymized is fine)

If you can send a minimal ZIP with stubs and a one-page README that explains redaction rules and timestamps, that will keep our intake lightweight.

Also copy your internal lead — we will route questions to Crowe if they need clarifications.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Finx needs this package to clear procurement gates.

Best,
Julie Park
Security & Risk, Finx Payments

Subject: Re: Evidence ask: compact roster + SCIM delta for Finx Prod

Quick tech notes and runbook for the artifacts:

1) SCIM delta extraction
- Query: scim_events where tenant_id = 'finx-prod' and timestamp between '2025-11-01T00:00:00Z' and '2025-11-02T23:59:59Z'
- Output: scim_delta_sample.csv (columns: op_type, timestamp, user_id, external_id, attributes_changed)
- Redaction: emails replaced with hashed identifiers; user.displayName preserved when not PII-sensitive

2) Compact role roster
- Generated from the authorization catalog service; includes role_id, role_name, primary_owner, provisioning_source (SCIM/API/manual), last_modified
- Format: role-mapping-compact.xlsx and service-account-ownership.csv for accounts flagged as 'service'

3) Privileged/service account justification
- We will include a short rationale (1-2 lines) for each service account that has >1 high-scope role in the last 90 days. Sensitive notes will be redacted and an owner contact provided.

4) SAML assertion samples
- We will provide two anonymized assertion captures (saml_assertion_sample_1.xml, saml_assertion_sample_2.xml) with timestamps and the SP/IdP entity IDs. Crowe: if you need full assertion XMLs (unredacted) we need an executed NDA or a connected evidence channel; please advise.

Estimated outputs for first drop (11/27): scim_delta_sample.csv, role-mapping-compact.xlsx, saml_assertion_sample_1.xml (anonymized), README.txt.

Attachments referenced: scim_delta_sample.csv (stub), role-mapping-compact.xlsx (stub)

—Jonas
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Vanessa / team — this looks great, thanks for the clear runbook. The 11/27 first drop is perfect for our intake. Two quick clarifications:

1) For the SCIM delta CSV, can you include a column 'role_snapshot' that lists the role IDs present at each delta row? That will help our mapping engine.
2) For any service accounts with delegated access, can you flag 'delegation_source' (SCIM vs manual) in the service-account-ownership.csv?

If you can add those columns to the first drop, we’ll be able to start the automated reconciliation earlier and should finish our review before procurement cutover next week. I’ll open a HubSpot ticket and attach the procurement checklist.
